nom: RoC Multi Correxion Hydrate + Plump Hyaluronic Acid Eye Cream

avis.texte: used this product for a month, could not tell any difference.
This was a waste of money - tiny, expensive tube that does not deliver on what it says it does.
This is so gentle under my eyes, my skin and eyes are very sensitive but have no issues with this product. Retains moisture and looks refreshed.
This is my go to eye cream at 55 years. It hydrates and leaves my eyes bright and youthful!

avis.titre: If Ulta ships the right item, this is a great product
avis.texte: I have been an Ulta member since 2017. I am currently platinum so it's upsetting to have to write this in a product review but I'm getting nowhere with Customer Service. I placed an order for this item December 3 and Ulta has now shipped the wrong item 3 times (on just this order). Each time making me wait 5 to 7 days in between. Very disappointed in Customer Service not sure what's going on at Ulta, but hope someone in charge reads this and gets a handle on it.
I just purchased two weeks ago and this it's the best product I been use …. Love it

I've been using this cream about 5 days and it that time, I've developed 3 styes. I never get those! I had a very slight warming sensation when I put it on, but it was short, so I ignored it. I shouldn't have! I don't even put it all the way up to my lash line, just on the hollows area, outer corner away from my eye, and on my brow bone. I will say that it is very smooth (Dimethicone), lightweight, and my concealer went on smoothly.
I have noticed a little difference in my lines near my eyes but will keep using, hopefully to see more

avis.titre: Doesn't live up to the description
avis.texte: I've used this product for more than 90 days and it does not reduce crow's feet lines or under eye puffiness
I've been using this about a month, and I can see a difference. My eyes look more awake and smooth
As I'm getting older, I started getting Festoons above my cheek bones. This eye cream relieves the puffiness and makes me feel much more confident!
I love ROC eye cream because it keeps the delicate skin around my eyes hydrated and youthful looking. It does not sting if it gets into the eyes.

avis.titre: Caused stinging and watering in eyes
avis.texte: I just bought this and tried it for the first time. However, within about 15-20 minutes, my eyes were stinging and watering. I finally flushed it out and it feels better now, but I will not be using this any more. Even after I flushed off my eyes, they were very puffy underneath.
I was looking for an eye cream without retinol because I am pregnant. This eye cream met my expectations and I am very happy with my purchase.

avis.titre: Love but PLEASE change the packaging
avis.texte: I love this formula so much but the tube is an absolute nightmare. It comes out on its own as soon as you open it and leaks all over the place, especially badly after a pressure change with traveling. I'm probably going to have to start decanting it into something else, but I just wish they would change it!! It's seriously so bad and wastes so much product.
Nice and hydrating eye cream. I like that it is more of a gel texture. It absorbs quickly and is great for prepping for concealer under the eye.

I liked it at first as the clear serum absorbed nicely. After a week, I noticed it sitting on top of my skin. Week two, I haven't noticed any real value, it sits on top of my eye areas like Vaseline. This is after cleansing and a good toner. I also noticed some new pimples under my eye area.

I've used Multi Correxion Hydrate & Plump Eye Cream for a while now and I like it. It absorbs nicely and makes my skin feel soft. I can't use anything near my eyes that have a heavy fragrance or almost any fragrance at all. I do not have a problem with this product causing me any problems with that.

Struggle with under eye puffiness even with good nights sleep. Tried many products from every price range. Based on reviews, decided to try this. Been using for 2 weeks. Noticed minor improvement first week of use. Second week puffiness showed noticed improvement. Will continue to use and hope to see more improvement.

I purchased this item a few weeks ago. I like the product however when I open it the product leaks out and is very runny. I saw other reviews with the same issue. ROC you might want to consider to change the packaging. Or make a larger version in a jar type
This is by far the best eye cream I've ever used. It's amazing for puffiness and fine lines, it's my holy grail. Buy it, stick with it and you'll never go back.

avis.titre: Great for sensitive eyes and skin
avis.texte: My skin is so sensitive and a lot of eye creams irritate my skin or they dont work at all. This is amazing for adding hydration to my eye area and i can use it even when my eyes are acting up and are so sensitive. Works well under makeup, but also at night. Love that it comes in a tube. I wish more eye creams did bc its more sanitary
I am using this product for a second time. I am satisfied with the results.
This product abdirbs quickly and I've definitely noticed a difference in my under eye.
This product abdirbs quickly and I've definitely noticed a difference in my under eye.

I've been using this eye cream since I turned 25 and saw I was getting fine lines by my eyes. Plus dark circles that I'd had as for so long. I am now 30 and my under eyes look better than they did when I was 19! No joke. I have no darkness under my eyes and they glow after applying this cream! Must have when you get to the right age!!
I love the way it smooths out under my eyes. Less puffiness and helps with brightening.

I think I've noticed a difference in my under eyes since using this cream which has been now for almost a year. My under eye feels hydrated and smooth and dark circles seem a bit more faint. My only complaint is that the tube keeps tearing as I am close to finishing it causing me to waste so much product. It's so annoying.
I love it. It seems to have more lift than most other brands & it feels good going on.
I love this product! It makes the skin around my eyes so smooth! Lasts long for a small tube.
I immediately saw an improvement in the texture and puffiness below my lower lids. With continued use, the fine lines were greatly diminished.

avis.titre: Can't tell any difference. Not very hydrating.
avis.texte: CeraVe seems much better. Don't like the tube either, too much product comes out at a time. Will not buy again.

I really like the consistency, application and price! But the only downside is the tub is a metal material where if you leave it uncapped it slowly seeps out. I don't want to lose product. But small complaint.

Great product. I have been a Lancome and Elizabeth Arden user for over 40 years. I have made the switch. If you are aware of the two products I mentioned then you know how outrageous their price tags! Im now using all of the steps with this product line! My face, kneck look great! I havent seen one difference in product.

avis.titre: Multi Correxion Hydrate & Plump Eye Cream
avis.texte: I have just started using this product last week. I like that is goes on smoothly and absorbs rather quickly, which is a plus. It seems that my eye area looks brighter and the lines are not quite as noticeable. This is the first time that I have used Roc products and so far I am impressed.

avis.titre: Eyes are burning from using this product
avis.texte: I love the skin care items and have used them for years. The under-eye cream is different. Yes, it does reduce the look of find lines under my eyes. But my eyes seem to be paying the price! They're red and burning. I've used this product twice. My eyes burned the first time, but I thought I may have accidently gotten some in my eye. Not this time. I won't use it again, and I'm returning it to the store where I purchased it.
This repaired my under eye area! I had deep lines and dryness. Honestly I'm super impressed.

I use a trenitonin and a retinol for my hormonal acne. I use the original brand, so I figured I could try this one out. It burns slightly when I first apply it around my eyes. The burning does go away after maybe 30 seconds. It doesn't feel heavy. It feels creamy. And absorbs pretty well. I don't think it does anything for my dark circles and puffy eyes. A little goes a long way. I've been using this product for 2 weeks now. It may be too soon to give final results.

It was so difficult to find an eye cream that 1. Works 2. Comes in a tube not a jar 3. Didn't contain retinol 4. Wasn't unnecessarily overpriced I was so happy to find this because it checks all of those boxes. I mostly use it at night but it works under makeup as well. My undereye looks plumper, my lines have lessoned, this doesn't irritate my eyes. The only downside is the tube leaks when it's new from pressure. But I wouldn't change the packaging bc eye creams in jars skeave me out. This is a keeper.
Go get and buy it. Highly recommend it. Only the packaging is a disaster…. So I had to transfer it to a different container.

I have tried so many eye creams for so many years. Any top rated cream, I've tried it. All with underwhelming results. No matter what, my eye area always looked dry and crapy. Until I stumbled upon this literal GEM of a product! My eye area can be sensitive to many things. This absolutely hydrated and smoothed out my under eyes. With ulta coupons, you can get this under $25 and that's a solid steal. I will buy this again and again. My only qualm about it is the foil like packaging. If squeezed too much, the product will just ooze out. So you have to very gently squeeze and store this. Otherwise 10/10
I am amazed at how quickly I saw results from this product. It only takes a tiny amount so a tube will last you quite a while. Great product!
I am just finishing up my first tube. I keep this in the refrig. it feels so wonderfuls and cooling in the am. My favorite drugstore eyecream

I purchased this ROC eye cream to compare to a more $$ one. It was actually more soothing to my eyes and my concealer went on more smoothly over it. The packaging can easily get bent & cause too much product to come out which is my only negative. Handle with care!

avis.titre: Would buy this again and highly recommend it!
avis.texte: Use it a.m. and p,m. Stays moist and in place. Reduces undereye bags but I don't have any wrinkles so I don't know about that. Am 73 with terrific skin. Love this product.

I am almost 35 and have very dry skin. I have used a plethora of eye creams over the years, and none of them have given me the results that this one has in just a few short weeks. My under eyes are FINALLY hydrated looking, my fine lines are not nearly as noticeable and my concealer goes on so smoothly now. I absolutely love this, and a little goes a long way. My only negative is the packaging… when I open it, I don't even have to squeeze before the eye cream starts squirting out so a lot of it get stuck in the lid. But for overall results, this stuff rocks!

avis.titre: Not for me. Made my eyes look worse
avis.texte: With great reviews, I decided to try this. Not only did it not work, it actually made my troubled spots worse. The fine lines under my eyes became deep wrinkles. I do not recommend.

I love the gel texture of this under eye cream. It absorbs very quickly. It goes under makeup really well. I actually like to mix it with with a little bit of concealer for under my eyes. Overall, my under eye area looks very hydrated. I will definitely buy again.

So I have tried numerous eye creams for dark eye circles and puffiness. It's a daily fight for me. I got this and decided to give it the full try. I had a concert coming up the next day so I stayed up all night because I had stuff to do before I could go I didn't want to go to this concert looking like I hadn't slept even though I hadn't so I use this product and I could tell a difference my best friend didn't know I hadn't slept so obviously she could see the difference too haha it's lightweight, non greasy, unscented and I can easily lay make up over it if I decide to that day or just wear it out without it leaving some light white residue under the eye. I love this product and I'll definitely buy it again.

I've tried many under eye creams and nothing compares to this! Doesn't cause milia to form like others I have tried. This is definitely hydrating and feels like it plumps the under eye up. Very moisturizing! Must buy if you are struggling with dry under eyes especially when no concealer works because they are so dry and everything seems to settle and look cakey. Definitely noticed a difference when applying my concealer. 10/10 recommend!!!

I have only been using this product for 2 weeks. I have used ROC products for several years. My skin has stayed fresh with very little deep wrinkles. I trust ROC products and will continue to use them as my routine skin care regimen!

I have used a million eye creams and I really love this one! The texture of the cream is great, absorbs into my skin easily that I can wear it under makeup and does not get into my eye and cause any irritation.

I got this product a month ago and I love the results I got. So I went and got the whole RoC line of product to us with this one. Highly recommend because they work amazing! I love a company that really stands by the product.
Moisturized well, but did nothing for puffy under eyes and dark circles.

I received this product a few weeks ago. So far I can tell a but of difference. I feel like it has helped some of my fine lines under my eyes and makes me not look so tired, which is a very hard thing to do.

avis.titre: Works on dark circles and puffiness
avis.texte: ROC Multi Correxion Hydrate + Plump Eye Cream is a very nice smooth product that goes on to your skin smooth like a serum. It moisturizes the eye area and after a few uses you can see the fine lines and wrinkles become taut and disappear. It goes on easily and dissolves into your skin quickly. I noticed results and I would buy this again and continue to use as it works.

I've been using this eye cream for about 3 weeks and I love it so far. It goes on smoothly and absorbs quickly. It's not heavily scented like some other products I've used. I have noticed the fine lines at the corner of my eyes aren't as noticeable and my under eye area is clearer and healthy looking.
I am 26, and I have been using this for a week now. I really enjoy the texture of this gel cream. It absorbs very quickly. It makes me look more awake, and my undereye smoother.

I had got this product a while back. I was looking for some eye cream that wouldn't break me out or cause irritation to my eyes. This product works, after about 7 to 10 days I started to see a difference.

I have tried this Multi correxion hydrate plump eye cream for a month now! I can say it works. But the cost of the product is to high that is why I have gave it 4 stars not 5 stars. I love how it makes my skin around my eyes feel and look.

This was really nice eye cream. It was very smooth & went on well. No problems with allergies like I usually have when I try using eye cream. No strong smell or melting & running on my skin. I really liked it.

i have been using this cream for about 2 weeks and i have noticed visible difference. My skin feels more elastic and tight, less visible wrinkles, less saggy around eyes. Cream absorbs quickly and doesn't leave thick layer on skin. Doesn't have any strong smell to it. Gives you feel of the lift right after use.

I've used the MULTI CORREXION Hydrate & Plump Eye Cream for the last two weeks. I have noticed some improvement in the fine lines around my eyes. I am very pleased with the results and can't wait to see the results after using for a longer period of time.

I started using this almost 2 weeks ago and so far I have enjoyed it. I am not completely in love but I do think it's a great cream. I want to look more into this brand and it's products to find more that fit my needs.

When I first pumped out this product, I wasn't sure how it would absorb underneath my eyes but it feels so hydrating. I use this in the morning and night religiously. I don't see or feel dryness around the eyes as I used to so this product seems to be doing the job!

Aging is not fun and it is a struggle to handle keeping younger look. I am starting to get some fine lines and dark circles. I started using this to see if it can help. 2 weeks later I am starting to see a difference. I hopei t continues.

I started using the Roc Multi Correction eye a few weeks ago. I have noticed a difference in the puffiness under my eyes. Improvement! It goes on very light and absorbs quickly. I use it under make up and at night. I am so glad I am using it!

I've only been using this for a few weeks but already my eyes feel and look much more hydrated and bright. I have bags and dark circles that I've had since I was a baby and I've tried for years to cover and hide them. This cream makes them look less puffy and tired and more bright and awake. It goes on super smooth and seems to sink right into my skin for a great hydrated feeling. It's not sticky afterwards and the fragrance is minimal which I like more than heavily scented face or eye creams. Can't wait to see what my eyes look like in a few more weeks if Im already seeing results like this. Gives me hope that I won't always have to try to hide and cover up my under eye area

I have been using this product for a couple of weeks and it does hydrate the eye area and makes my crows feet less visible. I like that it is unscented. It isn't greasy and absorbs into the skin very well. I chill mine in the refrigerator, so it instantly takes away any puffiness as well. If you are beginning to see the signs of aging. Especially crows feet, then this is the eye cream for you.

avis.titre: It is very easy to use!
avis.texte: With continued use it works good. I used Multi Correction Hydrate & Plump Eye Cream every night and day and was excited seeing good results. I will continue to use this product since it lives up to it's claims.

I have been using this product for about two weeks now and I can definitely see a difference. I'm the girl who never sleeps which unfortunately also makes me the girl who's got massive bags under her eyes to cover. After a week of using day and night, I could already start to see my eyes more hydrated and the bags were less noticeable. The cream is super soft and melts into your skin. It's also great with sensitive skin which I have. I love that there is no odor and it doesn't leave an icky residue. Overall, I'm really liking the results and will continue to use.

This eye cream works great! I have noticed my eye bags improving and being less visible. It is easy to apply, absorbs quickly into the skin, not too thick, and fragrance free. I have been using RoC products for years and can always count on them to deliver. I definitely recommend it.

I've been using this RoC - MULTI CORREXION Hydrate & Plump Eye Cream for two weeks. This is light and unscented. I use it twice a day. It helps with dark circles and it absorbs quickly. It's great under makeup as well. Worth to try it!

I've been using this product for about two weeks and I already love it. It's gentle enough that I haven't had any issues with my contact lenses. Once I put it on my eye area I feel a slight, but pleasing tingle. I like to think of it as giving my eyes their morning cup of coffee. Will definitely continue using it!

I'm very impressed with the quality of this eye cream. It has a nice texture and absorbs nicely into my skin. It's lightweight and so far I've seen a bit of an improvement in my skin. My eyes look brighter and not as full since using this cream. Great product.

I ordered the Roc multi correction hydrate and plump eye cream a few weeks ago. I feel this product works. I am a mom, who is busy busy and notice my under eyes are puffy. I use the cream twice a day and I feel I look less puff. As a mom we need to take care of ourselves and I feel this is one small way I have been able too.

This eye cream is fantastic for your everyday use. It's super hydrating and wakes up my eyes a little bit first thing in the morning. I've found that it's long term use leads to more visible results, where when I used it first the results were not immediately visible. It works well under my makeup and is not tacky at all and does not irritate my eyes or have a strong smell. It's a nice complement to serums you might have and has hyaluronic acid which plumps. After continued use, I've even felt like I look refreshed and great without makeup. I really like this this eye cream.

I feel like my eyes are aging faster with the amount of staring at my phone/laptop. I've been trying to help my eyes look not as tired but I also have really sensitive eyes so it's been a bit of an issue. So far I've not had irritation to my eyes which I love. It's pretty smooth and absorbs quickly

I have noticeable fine wrinkles under my eyes and have been blessed with those lovely dark circles and have tried for many years to find a product that actually makes a difference. First thing I noticed was an immediate difference to the wrinkles. Much less noticeable with just the first use! It could be just the super hydration that made the difference that first time but even after a few weeks the cream has continued to improve my skin. Not only that but the bonus is the dark circles have actually started to fade in the outer corner of under my eye. I've never had any success in getting rid of the dark circles but I'm hoping with continued use they will continue to lighten up. I also use this cream before I apply my coverup with no problems. Roc never seems to disappoint when it comes to their products!

I recently got this Multi-Correction Hydrate Plump and Eye Cream and I love it. It smells great, the application is smooth and a little bit of product covers a great amount of surface. It has my eyes looking bright and I love it, and you can't beat it's affordability.

I love that a very little bit of this cream goes a long way. The cream rubs in easily and doesn't have any smell. I'm just a week I've noticed the area around my eyes are smoother. My under eye bags aren't as bad and some of my crows feet are less noticeable.

I am a bit of a skincare snob so when I tried this I was skeptical it would do anything. However, I saw that it had several noteworthy ingredients including glycerin, niacinamide, and copper peptides.. I've been using this for about 4 weeks and my skin definitely feels more hydrated and plump.. It's actually so good I like to rub a little around my cheeks and nasolabial area. I added a photo to show how hydrated my skin is looking.. Ignore the ratchet eyelash lol.. This stuff is so good I'd like to see it in a full face cream because I'd definitely repurchase.

We can't turn back the hands of time,above all my skincare is top priority .I started using ROC about two weeks now and I need to see results in the first week to continue use of any product,ROC has not disappointed me .I have noticed my eye area slightly more smoother with no irritation or breakouts.ROC is not oily and only a little is needed to fully cover eye area.The size is great and easily packs in any bag .I love the results so far and will definitely will use again,great price ,great product for most ages.

The Multi Correxion Hydrate & Plump Eye Cream is good. It does leave my undereyes feel more refreshed and give them a hydrated and supple look. They make my under eyes seem brighter because they are moisturized and glowy. I am able to apply makeup and concealer over it without leaving any residue behind and applies smoothly over it. It doesn't have any scent which I live and it's very light and absorbs easily. The only reason I do not give this 5 starts is because I didn't see improvement on lines with continued use, however I will continue using it as a moisturizer and eye cream since that works very well.

I got this RoC MULTI CORREXION Hydrate & Plump Eye Cream and it's ok. A little goes a long way. It absorbs quickly. It's non greasy. It has no scent. I used it several times on my crows feet and under eye bags but didn't see really any difference after I applied it.

This is nice lightweight eye cream. I am very sensitive to scents so I was pleased that this has no odor at all. It absorbs very quickly, which is nice when I am running late in the morning--i don't have to wait long before applying my eye makeup. It also seems to be pretty effective at reducing lines and under eye circles.

Obviously this is a product that takes months to see real results. However after 2 weeks of use I've noticed less puffiness around my eyes. Love the consistency. It also absorbs very well. It's even helped with dark circles!

RoC's Multi Correxion Hydrate & Plump Eye Cream glides so smoothly onto the skin. It feels wonderful! Both the package and the tube are designed nicely and make this feel expensive and fancy. The cream is easy to dispense out of the tube-you will be able to use just about every drop of the product with the materials they used. You may use this in the morning or at night, making it easy to add to your beauty regimen. I love that it has hyaluronic acid and peptides. I enjoy using this eye cream and will continue to do so for a long time. I would recommend this to others looking to benefit from the use of a great eye cream.

This is a really effective eye cream. As I have grown older, I have tried to focus more on ensuring that I pay special attention to the skin under my eyes, and the goals of this cream are exactly what I am looking for. I can tell there are positive results after a couple of weeks.

This eye cream works very well for me! The texture is lightweight and glides on the skin flawlessly for a great application. It absorbs instantly into the skin and leaves a very soft, silky feeling after. I love using it in the AM to refresh my eyes and it hydrates the delicate skin under my eyes for hours. It's also great under makeup! I highly recommend this eye cream!

I like this eye cream, especially since under my eyes my skin has become dryer as I have gotten older. I need a good hydrating eye cream and this one works very well. It works as well as the more expensive eye cream I had been using.

avis.titre: Leaves my skin feeling smooth and plump
avis.texte: I usually use the Roc eye cream with Retinol so I already have a good impression of Roc to begin with. This eye cream is nice to use during the daytime and it leaves the skin around my eyes feeling moisturized and plump all day. Love using it!

Got this a few weeks ago. It's light and thin layer applied under the eyes seems to work. After the first use I could feel my under eye was slightly firmer than before applying. It's applied in a thin layer and I haven't had a problem using makeup after it dries.

I am in my late 20s and feel like I aged tremendously since having kids a few years ago. I haven't been great about taking care of my skin, so I decided to start now before it gets too late. I have heard great things about hyaluronic acid and reduction of wrinkles and fine lines, so I wanted an eye cream with that in it. I put this eye cream on before bed every night. It is more of a hydrating gel than a cream. It goes on smoothly and I definitely feel the hydration after it is on. I don't see much of a change with the wrinkles under my eyes, but I didn't expect to see a change right away. I do notice though that my eyes don't look as puffy, even when I don't get the full 7 hours of sleep that I usually require. This product definitely hydrates my under eyes and I can't wait to use it for more time to see the effects that it can have on me and my tired, aging skin.

I tried using RoC eye cream on my crow's feet wrinkles around my eyes. After using for a few days, I started seeing an improvement in the texture of my skin. This is a great product, but I wish there was more of it instead of a small tube.

This eye cream is more of a gel and feels amazing going on. It absorbs into the skin quickly and leaves the skin around my eyes more hydrated than it's been in a long time. I have been using it for just over two weeks and I will definitely continue using it because I already see a difference in the lines around my eyes.

This stuff is phenomenal! My under eyes stay so dry and bleh looking. But, let me tell you how amazing they look after using this product! It took one week for me to notice a difference but even my mother in law noticed and asked what I had been using, so it's definitely amazing!

My eyes are showing my age and the windows to soul are very tired looking! After using this about 2 weeks in i can really tell a difference in the puffiness i had decreasing and the skin at corners of my eyes look more refreshed. The cream isnt greasy, oily or strong in scent. Will be using more and purchasing more from RoC I was impressed.

I've been using the Hydrate and Plump Cream for a couple weeks now. Right away your skin feels hydrated and soft. After several days I noticed the lines around my eyes started to fade. The wrinkles on the edges of my eyes are less noticable and I don't look so tired in the mirror.

avis.titre: Just what I've been looking for!
avis.texte: I've only used this for about a week and it actually works! I'm so excited to find something that does what they say it does. The bags around my eyes have tightened up and makes me look younger ☺ I'm looking forward to trying more of the RoC skin care products.

I started using RoC Multi Correxion Eye Cream & I saw visible results after only 2 days!! I have under-eye bags & fine wrinkles. Within days I noticed a dramatic difference! I can't wait to see how I look after 2 weeks! I have tried so many name-brand eye creams with very little result. It'll be RoC from now on!!

I got this a little over a week ago. I work long hours and my eyes show it. I wanted something to cleat the puffiness and fine lines so I would look refreshed and awake. This product absolutely did the trick. My eyes appear refreshed and diminished the lines around them. Thank goodness for this lifesaver

avis.titre: Awesome eye cream for eye bags!
avis.texte: RoC's Multi Correxion Hydrate + Plump Eye Cream is a great eye cream if you are looking to reduce bags, crow's feet and wrinkles. After the first week of using this product, I definitely noticed the bags under my eyes were much less visible. I'm only into my second week, but any of the wrinkles around my eye are less noticeable as well. I also love that this is a fragrance free eye cream. I am looking forward to seeing my results after 4 weeks of using this product, but I definitely recommend buying it and trying it for yourself.

ROC's Multi Correxion Hydrate & Plump Eye Cream is great. This eye cream is great. I noticed my eye area is hydrated and plumper than before trying it. I definitely will use again and recommend to others. Easy to dap on and soaks in the skin quickly. No smell. No irritation, just results. I have used it for two weeks so far and will continue to use it daily.

Let me start by saying I have extremely sensitive skin and hesitated to try something new, especially around my eyes but SURPRISE!! No burning, no irritation, no itching AND it works! The dark circles under my eyes are fading, puffiness is gone, and the scent isn't offensive at all. After trying one product after another, wasting I don't know how much money I finally found one that works so ladies stop wasting your money on items with big promises and zero results and buy Roc!!

I was noticing fine lines around my eyes and my eyes were also looking tired. Older than what they were. After using this product for a short time I was able to notice a difference in the lines and I feel my eyes have a more "awake" look to them too! Definitely pleased with how this product works!!

I use several Roc products and this one does not disappoint. This is a gel which is very soothing feels like you had been laying down with cucumbers on your eyes. It goes on smoothly and seems to really hydrate my eyes without feeling heavy. I have been using morning and night for about week now and my area around my eyes looks so much brighter

I waited to post my review until I could use this eye cream product on myself for at least a week. So glad I waited, because at first I did notice it visibly smoothed out the wrinkles around my eyes, and "crows feet", but now after a week's use, I'm noticing when I wake up in the morning the dark bags under my eyes are diminished and the puffiness in going down. Probably the feature I love best is how it goes on, just like silk. Love it!

I am not one to gush over any product but I am this time!! Roc Multi-Correxion Eye Cream is wonderful. I am a Roc-User because their products work so when I came across this new product, I knew I had to try it. I smoothed the cream in on one eye area. I waited a few minutes and looked back in the mirror and there was definately a difference....a positive difference! My eyes area looked younger, with less bags and darkness. I can't wait until the 2nd week to see how well it does on fine lines and wrinkles....and crow's feet. Love Love Love this cream!

This RoC eye cream is one of the very few that I actually notice a difference with. I have deep tear troughs under my eyes, and this cream really helps to plump that area up. I actually noticed a difference after just one use! Love it!

I have only been using Roc Multi Correxion eye cream for about a week now and in the beginning I started using it in the AM and it seemed to take time to really notice any difference. I then started using it at night and WOW what a difference it has made. I no longer have big puffiness under my eyes in the morning. I'm really grateful to find a product that actually works. Thanks Roc

I've used this product during my nighttime and morning skincare routines for almost 2 weeks now. I'm so impressed by how hydrating and luxurious this eye cream is! My skin is very pale, and I normally don't get the typical dark under eye circles, instead my under eye area gets very puffy and red. This eye cream has really helped minimize the puffiness (especially in the mornings), resulting in a much less tired look. I also really enjoy the packaging, which gives you control of exactly how much product is deposited, while also remaining very sanitary. I definitely recommend this eye cream and will purchase again!

I have very sensitive skin so I'm always concerned when I try new products. Thankfully I've had no negative reaction with this product. I've been using it morning and night (when I remember) and I do see a difference. I'm 56 and have had dark circles under my eyes as long as I can remember. The puffiness appears to be getting worse the older I get and now I've got some sagginess. This product seems to plump up the rest so the area around my eyes appears firmer. I recommend and will continue to use!

I received the multi correction eye cream about two weeks ago and I really like it ... I can see the fine lines starting to fade away and I like how it hydrates the skin all day . I will definitely recommend this product to my friends and family .

avis.titre: Noticeable results after 1 week of use.
avis.texte: The Roc Multi Correxion Hydrate & Plump eye cream worked well from the first use. I have been using it in the morning and evening. I have older skin, and wrinkles, laugh lines. I notice a big difference already in the deepness. The areas around my mouth and eyes stay hydrated all day. I will continue to use this product, a little goes a long way. The Hydrate & Plump eye cream does not leave any sticky residue and had just a light fragrance.
